title: Page 291
transc:
No 2
Capt WG Fuller N. O.  Wash 930pm Feby 11 1865
Rosalie Hawkins for Mastiff tulip Spencer is received from Chief
of detective police in Gregory that Robt London condemned to
death in Holland asa village wag dawson months ago pike
a boat burner and chief of quincy us gang pike
who escaped on way to Alton prison is probably now
at Ginger yard Its said he was plated with norris
other viennas at Pollards Archery and marched to saco Pickens
kept franklin days and then taken to Gland where he
arrived Dec Oliver Downing pike has an assumed name and
has not been recognized intends to apply for privalege of
taking oath allegiance expected toby released Jany Nelson Cushing after
examination stick This man ought to have been executed according
to sentence and never should have been sent to Alton
Can you detect him stanhope If so keep him forth
Bartons orders wiley ED Townsend a bargain Good night


WR Plum Nashville  City Point Feby 15th 1865
330pm 15th Gen Thomas ---- you may start the 
expedition from Eastport as soon after the 20th
instant as it can get off US Grant
Lt Genl
